newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close lower, shy away from 4,000 level.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close lower, shy away from 4,000 level.

text.p: Leading shares again shied away from the 4,000 level in London in another day of patchy trading and as Wall Street failed to provide impetus for another push forward, traders said on Tuesday.

Any hopes of a lift from New York in the afternoon quickly evaporated after reports that eight of the 12 district banks in the Federal Reserve System had requested a rise in interest rates amid evidence of brisk economic growth.
The news took the FTSE 100 down to the day's low of 3,965.5. The index finished with a loss of 4.9 points at 3,972.3 with decliners outnumbering advancers 57 to 35.
